permissions.description: Search, tail and read job logs (search_logs, tail_logs, read_logs).

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-read-artifacts
permissions.description: List and download build and job artifacts (list_artifacts_for_build, list_artifacts_for_job, get_artifact).

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-read-tests
permissions.description: View Test Engine suites, tests, test runs, failed and slowest executions, execution traces and test workflows.

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-read-skills
permissions.description: Discover and load the server's built-in usage guides for Buildkite MCP tools (list_skills, load_skill).

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-write-clusters
permissions.description: Create and update clusters, cluster queues, cluster secrets and cache registries, pause or resume queue dispatch, and set or delete the default cache registry.

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-write-pipelines
permissions.description: Create and update pipelines and pipeline schedules, create repository webhooks, and enable or disable GitHub webhook processing.

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-write-builds
permissions.description: Trigger, cancel and rebuild builds, and retry, cancel or unblock jobs (create_build, cancel_build, rebuild_build, retry_job, retry_failed_jobs, cancel_job, unblock_job).

permissions.name: buildkite-mcp-write-annotations
permissions.description: Create annotations on builds and jobs (create_annotation).

cal-com-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Cal.com hosted MCP server (mcp.cal.com).

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Cal.com content.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: View anything in Cal.com without changing it: your profile, event types, events, bookings and attendees, schedules, availability and connected calendars, teams, organization members and attributes, routing forms, documentation, and the list of available API operations. Includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Make any change in Cal.com: update your profile; create, edit, duplicate or delete event types and schedules; create, reschedule, cancel, confirm or add attendees to bookings; manage team and organization memberships and attributes; create and edit routing forms; and run any Cal.com API operation. Includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-docs
permissions.description: Search the Cal.com documentation, build links to pages in the Cal.com web app, and browse the catalog of Cal.com API operations and the inputs they take, without running any of them.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-profile
permissions.description: View your own Cal.com user profile.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-profile
permissions.description: Update your own Cal.com user profile, such as your name, time zone or default settings.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-event-types
permissions.description: View event types along with their settings, scheduling configuration, change history and CRM sync errors.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-event-types
permissions.description: Create, edit, duplicate or delete event types.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-bookings
permissions.description: View bookings, their attendees and routing details, including bookings of organization teams and users, as well as fixed-date events (RSVP pages) that you own or co-host.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-bookings
permissions.description: Create, reschedule, cancel or confirm bookings, mark attendees as absent, and add attendees to bookings.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-schedules
permissions.description: View availability schedules (including your default schedule), check available time slots and busy times, and view connected calendars and conferencing apps.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-schedules
permissions.description: Create, edit or delete availability schedules.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-teams-and-organizations
permissions.description: View the teams you belong to, organization teams and their memberships, organization memberships, organization attributes and the attributes assigned to users.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-teams-and-organizations
permissions.description: Invite people to teams; add, change or remove team and organization memberships; and assign, update or unassign attributes on users.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-read-routing-forms
permissions.description: View routing forms, their responses and change history, and calculate the time slots a routing form response leads to.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-write-routing-forms
permissions.description: Create routing forms and edit their questions and routes.

permissions.name: cal-com-mcp-call-api-operations
permissions.description: Run any Cal.com API operation, which can read or change anything the account has access to.

canva-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Canva hosted MCP server (mcp.canva.com).

permissions.name: canva-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Canva content.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: View anything in Canva without changing it: search and read designs, export designs, browse assets, folders, comments, brand templates and brand kits, and check the progress of background jobs. Also includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Create and change things in Canva: generate, create, copy, resize, import and edit designs, generate and edit images, upload assets, create folders and move items, post comments, and work with brand templates. Also includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-designs
permissions.description: Find and view designs: search for designs, open a design's details, pages, text content, presenter notes and thumbnail, resolve shared Canva links, and check whether a design that is being created is ready.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-export-designs
permissions.description: Export a design as a downloadable file (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, GIF or MP4) and see which export formats a design supports. Does not change the design.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-create-designs
permissions.description: Create new designs: generate designs with AI, start a blank design, copy, merge or resize existing designs, and import files from a URL as new designs.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-edit-designs
permissions.description: Edit the content of existing designs: open an editing session, change text and elements, and save or discard the changes.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-assets
permissions.description: View the images, videos and other media assets in the user's Canva library.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-assets
permissions.description: Upload images, videos and other media into the user's Canva library, from a URL or via an upload link.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-images
permissions.description: Check the progress and results of image generation and image layer separation jobs.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-images
permissions.description: Generate images with AI, remove image backgrounds, and split images into separate layers.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-folders
permissions.description: Browse and search folders and list the designs, images and folders inside them.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-folders
permissions.description: Create folders and move designs, images and folders between folders.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-comments
permissions.description: View the comments and replies on a design.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-comments
permissions.description: Post comments on a design and reply to existing comments.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-read-brand-templates
permissions.description: Search brand templates, list brand kits, and view the data fields a brand template or design can be filled with. Requires Canva Pro or above.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-write-brand-templates
permissions.description: Create designs from brand templates, autofill templates with data, and create or publish brand templates. Requires Canva Pro or above.

permissions.name: canva-mcp-help
permissions.description: Ask the Canva MCP server for guidance on how to use it. Does not read or modify any Canva content.

fastmail.description: Any request to Fastmail's JMAP API or its blob download host. Accounts are homed on regional shards, so the API host may carry a shard prefix (phl.api.fastmail.com) and the blob host may carry a matching one (phl-www.fastmailusercontent.com).

permissions.name: fastmail-session
permissions.description: Fetch the JMAP session document, which names the apiUrl, downloadUrl and account ids. Required for any JMAP client to function; reveals account metadata but no mail, contact or calendar content.

permissions.name: fastmail-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything over JMAP: the session document, any /get, /changes, /query, /queryChanges or /parse method call, and blob downloads. Every method call in the batch must be a read, so a single write anywhere in the envelope fails to match.

permissions.name: fastmail-write-all
permissions.description: Create, update or delete anything over JMAP (any /set, /copy, /import or /upload method call), and upload blobs. Includes sending mail via EmailSubmission/set — grant fastmail-send-mail alone if that is the only write needed.

permissions.name: fastmail-read-mail
permissions.description: Read mailboxes, threads, messages and search snippets (RFC 8621).

permissions.name: fastmail-write-mail
permissions.description: Create, update, move or delete mailboxes and messages. Does not include sending — that is fastmail-send-mail.

permissions.name: fastmail-send-mail
permissions.description: Send mail on the account's behalf (EmailSubmission/set). Separate from fastmail-write-mail because sending is externally visible and irreversible.

permissions.name: fastmail-read-contacts
permissions.description: Read address books and contact cards (RFC 9610), including the legacy Contact and ContactGroup types.

permissions.name: fastmail-write-contacts
permissions.description: Create, update or delete address books and contact cards.

permissions.name: fastmail-read-calendars
permissions.description: Read calendars and calendar events (RFC 8984 / JSCalendar over JMAP).

permissions.name: fastmail-write-calendars
permissions.description: Create, update or delete calendars and calendar events, including sending invitations to participants.

permissions.name: fastmail-download-blobs
permissions.description: Download message sources and attachments from the blob host named by the session document's downloadUrl.

permissions.name: fastmail-upload-blobs
permissions.description: Upload blobs (attachments, message sources) for later use in a method call.

fastmail.description: Any request to Fastmail's CardDAV or CalDAV hosts. Separate from fastmail-api because these endpoints take an app password over Basic auth rather than the JMAP OAuth token.

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-discover
permissions.description: Discover the authenticated principal and the collections belonging to it (a current-user-principal PROPFIND, RFC 5397). Required before any DAV client can locate an address book or calendar.

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-read-all
permissions.description: Read any DAV resource: PROPFIND and REPORT to enumerate and sync collections, GET to fetch individual vCards or iCalendar objects.

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-write-all
permissions.description: Create, update or delete any DAV resource or collection.

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-read-contacts
permissions.description: Read address books and vCards over CardDAV (RFC 6352).

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-write-contacts
permissions.description: Create, update or delete address books and vCards over CardDAV.

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-read-calendars
permissions.description: Read calendars and iCalendar objects over CalDAV (RFC 4791).

permissions.name: fastmail-dav-write-calendars
permissions.description: Create, update or delete calendars and events over CalDAV, including scheduling messages sent to participants.

fathom-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Fathom hosted MCP server (api.fathom.ai, also reachable at fathom.video).

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Fathom content.

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any Fathom MCP tool (list and search recorded meetings, find the meetings a person took part in, read meeting transcripts and summaries, look up a recording from a link or call ID, see the connected account and its teams) plus the MCP session handshake. Fathom's hosted MCP server is read-only, so this covers every tool it offers; nothing can be created, changed or deleted.

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-read-meetings
permissions.description: Browse and search recorded meetings: list meetings with filters, search them by keyword, find the meetings a person took part in, and look up a recording from a meeting link or call ID. Does not return transcripts or summaries.

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-read-transcripts
permissions.description: Read the full transcript of a recorded meeting, including who said what and when.

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-read-summaries
permissions.description: Read the AI-generated summary of a recorded meeting.

permissions.name: fathom-mcp-read-account
permissions.description: See which Fathom account is connected (name and email) and which teams it belongs to.

gamma-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Gamma hosted MCP server (mcp.gamma.app).

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Gamma content.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Browse, search and read existing gammas, templates, themes, folders, comments and engagement analytics, export gammas to PDF, PPTX or PNG, and check the progress of generation, edit and export jobs. Does not create or change anything.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Create new gammas (presentations, documents, webpages, social posts) from scratch or from templates, generate images, and edit existing gammas. These actions consume Gamma credits.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-read-gammas
permissions.description: Browse and search existing gammas, read their full content and outline, and view the comments on them.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-read-workspace
permissions.description: Browse and search the available templates, themes and folders.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-read-analytics
permissions.description: View engagement analytics for a gamma, including per-card engagement and who viewed it.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-read-job-status
permissions.description: Check the progress and results of previously started generation, image, edit and export jobs.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-export-gammas
permissions.description: Export an existing gamma to PDF, PPTX or PNG and fetch the download link when it is ready.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-generate-gammas
permissions.description: Create new gammas (presentations, documents, webpages or social posts) from a prompt, as multi-page sites, or from a template. Consumes Gamma credits.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-generate-images
permissions.description: Create standalone images from a text prompt. Consumes Gamma credits.

permissions.name: gamma-mcp-edit-gammas
permissions.description: Change the content of an existing gamma using natural-language instructions (add, remove, reorder or rewrite cards). Consumes Gamma credits.

google-slides.description: Any request to the Google Slides API.

permissions.name: google-slides-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from Google Slides.

permissions.name: google-slides-write-all
permissions.description: Create, update, or delete anything in Google Slides.

permissions.name: google-slides-read-presentations
permissions.description: Read a specific presentation.

permissions.name: google-slides-create-presentations
permissions.description: Create new presentations.

permissions.name: google-slides-update-presentations
permissions.description: Apply batch updates to a presentation's content.

permissions.name: google-slides-read-pages
permissions.description: Read a specific page or its thumbnail from a presentation.

granola-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Granola hosted MCP server (mcp.granola.ai).

permissions.name: granola-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Granola content.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only Granola MCP tool (list and read meeting notes, transcripts, shared-screen screenshots and folders, ask questions about meetings, see the connected account) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any Granola MCP tool that changes something (create and edit folders, add or remove notes from folders, switch the active workspace, sign out) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-read-meetings
permissions.description: View meeting notes: list meetings, read their notes and AI summaries, see screenshots of content shared during meetings, and ask questions about past meetings.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-read-transcripts
permissions.description: Read the raw transcript of a meeting (paid plans only).

permissions.name: granola-mcp-read-folders
permissions.description: List the folders of meeting notes you have access to (paid plans only).

permissions.name: granola-mcp-write-folders
permissions.description: Create and rename folders, and add notes to or remove notes from folders. Adding a note to a shared folder shares it with everyone who can see the folder.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-read-account
permissions.description: See which Granola account and workspace are connected.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-switch-workspaces
permissions.description: Change the active Granola workspace, which also changes it in the Granola app and other connected AI tools.

permissions.name: granola-mcp-sign-out
permissions.description: Sign the AI tool out of the Granola account.

huggingface.description: Any Hugging Face API activity: the Hub API and repository file/git transfers on huggingface.co (or its hf.co alias), the Inference Providers router, the storage hosts that repository downloads and uploads are redirected to, and the dataset viewer. Does not cover, OAuth, the Hub MCP server, apps hosted on *.hf.space, or the Inference Endpoints management API.

permissions.name: huggingface-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from the Hugging Face APIs: list and search models, datasets and Spaces, inspect repositories, download files, and browse the dataset viewer. Safe methods only, including the HEAD request huggingface_hub issues before a download.

permissions.name: huggingface-write-all
permissions.description: Change anything through the Hugging Face APIs: create repositories, upload files, push commits, edit settings, manage Spaces, and submit jobs. Covers every unsafe method except requests to the inference router.

permissions.name: huggingface-inference
permissions.description: Run hosted inference through the Inference Providers router: a POST to router.huggingface.co. Consumes compute/quota.

permissions.name: huggingface-download
permissions.description: Download repository contents by any transport: resolve/raw file requests, the redirected CDN and Xet storage hosts, and a read-only Git clone or fetch (including the LFS batch call it needs). Does not grant access to the rest of the Hub API.

invideo-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the invideo hosted MCP server (mcp.invideo.io).

permissions.name: invideo-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify invideo content.

permissions.name: invideo-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Look at video projects without changing anything: list projects, read timelines, media and exports, and ask the server for help on how projects, timelines and media work, plus the MCP session handshake. invideo does not publicly document its MCP tool catalog, so this permission is based on tool-name conventions (tools whose names start with a read-style verb such as get, list or show).

permissions.name: invideo-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Create and edit video projects: bring in media, change timelines, branch and checkpoint edits, generate images, video and audio (which spends invideo credits), and export finished videos, plus the MCP session handshake. invideo does not publicly document its MCP tool catalog, so this permission is based on tool-name conventions (any tool whose name does not start with a read-style verb such as get, list or show).

linktree-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Linktree hosted MCP server (mcp.linktr.ee).

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Linktree content.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: View everything on a Linktree account without changing it: profiles, links, social icons, appearance, analytics, recommendations, workspaces and the messages inbox.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Make any change to a Linktree account: create and edit profiles, add, edit, reorder and delete links and social icons, change the appearance, record recommendation feedback and send replies to followers.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-profiles
permissions.description: View Linktree profiles the user can access and their details: display name, bio, suggested bio, connected social integrations, knowledge base entries and the profile sharing link. Also lets the agent pick which profile to work on.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-write-profiles
permissions.description: Create the user's first Linktree profile or change a profile's display name and bio.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-links
permissions.description: View the links, collections, shop products and social icons on a Linktree profile.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-write-links
permissions.description: Add, edit and reorder links, collections and social icons on a Linktree profile. Does not allow deleting them.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-delete-links
permissions.description: Delete links and social icons from a Linktree profile.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-appearance
permissions.description: View a Linktree profile's appearance settings: colors, fonts, button styles and background.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-write-appearance
permissions.description: Change a Linktree profile's appearance: colors, fonts, button styles and background.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-analytics
permissions.description: View Linktree analytics: profile views, clicks, click-through rates, earnings, top links, per-link trends and workspace-wide profile totals.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-recommendations
permissions.description: Get Linktree's suggestions for improving a profile.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-write-recommendations
permissions.description: Record whether the user accepted or declined a Linktree suggestion.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-workspaces
permissions.description: View the Linktree workspaces the user belongs to, their members and roles, and the profiles in each workspace.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-read-messages
permissions.description: Read conversations and messages from followers in a Linktree profile's inbox.

permissions.name: linktree-mcp-send-messages
permissions.description: Send replies to followers in a Linktree profile's inbox. Messages are sent immediately.

neon-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Neon hosted MCP server (mcp.neon.tech).

permissions.name: neon-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Neon data.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only Neon MCP tool (list and describe projects, branches, databases, roles, schemas, computes, snapshots, functions, storage, logs; explain queries and run database health checks; search Neon docs) plus the MCP session handshake. Does not execute arbitrary SQL and does not reveal connection strings or secrets.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any Neon MCP tool that creates, modifies or deletes something or exposes secrets (execute SQL and migrations; create, update, reset and delete projects, branches, databases, roles, computes, snapshots, functions, storage, Neon Auth, Data API and Realtime; obtain connection strings and secrets; send feedback) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-projects-and-branches
permissions.description: View Neon organizations, projects and branches: project settings, members, permissions, regions and operations, branch details and the default branch, and search across organizations, projects and branches (search, fetch).

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-databases
permissions.description: View Postgres databases and roles on a branch, inspect database schemas (tables, columns, constraints, all objects on a branch, schema diffs between branches) and analyze query performance (execution plans, slow queries, Neon's read-only health checks). Does not read table data.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-auth-and-credentials
permissions.description: View Neon Auth status and configuration for a branch (with secrets redacted), its trusted redirect domains, and metadata about scoped service credentials issued on the branch. Does not reveal secrets or connection strings.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-computes-and-snapshots
permissions.description: List and view compute endpoints, snapshots and a branch's automatic snapshot schedule.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-platform-add-ons
permissions.description: View the configuration of Neon's platform add-ons on a branch: the Data API, Functions (with their custom domains and triggers), object storage (buckets and object listings), Realtime (without its secret) and the AI Gateway endpoint host.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-read-logs-and-docs
permissions.description: Query branch logs (and their fields and values), and search and read Neon documentation, guides and blog posts on neon.com.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-projects-and-branches
permissions.description: Create and update Neon projects and branches, recover a recently deleted project, set a project's default branch, finalize a branch restored from a snapshot, and send anonymous feedback to the Neon team (send_feedback). Does not delete projects or branches.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-delete-projects-and-branches
permissions.description: Delete a Neon project with all of its branches and data (delete_project), delete a branch and all of its data (delete_branch), or reset a branch to its parent and discard its changes (reset_from_parent).

permissions.name: neon-mcp-run-sql
permissions.description: Execute arbitrary SQL on a Neon database: run statements and transactions directly (run_sql, run_sql_transaction), or prepare schema migrations and query-tuning changes on a temporary branch and then apply or discard them on the target branch. This can read, modify or delete any data or schema the connected role has access to.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-databases
permissions.description: Create and update Postgres databases on a branch, and create Postgres roles or reset their passwords. Does not delete databases or roles.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-delete-databases
permissions.description: Delete Postgres databases (and their data) or Postgres roles from a branch.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-auth-and-credentials
permissions.description: Manage access to a branch: enable, configure or disable Neon Auth and manage its OAuth providers (including viewing their secrets), trusted domains and users; and issue, rotate and revoke scoped service credentials for object storage and the AI Gateway. Does not reveal Postgres connection strings or passwords.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-get-connection-strings
permissions.description: Obtain Postgres connection strings, including the role password, for Neon databases (get_connection_string). These allow direct database access outside the MCP server.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-computes-and-snapshots
permissions.description: Create, update and delete compute endpoints and start, suspend or restart them; create, update and delete snapshots, change a branch's snapshot schedule and restore a snapshot onto a new or existing branch.

permissions.name: neon-mcp-write-platform-add-ons
permissions.description: Enable, configure, change or remove Neon's platform add-ons on a branch: the Data API; Functions with their custom domains and triggers; object storage buckets and objects (including deleting objects and creating presigned upload/download URLs); and Realtime, including viewing or rotating its shared secret.

netlify-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Netlify hosted MCP server (netlify-mcp.netlify.app, also served as mcp.netlify.com).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Netlify content.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only Netlify MCP tool (coding guidance, user and team info, projects and forms, deploys, extensions, database setup steps, observability queries and request logs, design-import status) on either tool surface (the netlify-*-services-reader selectors or the per-operation netlify-<domain>-<operation> tools), plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any Netlify MCP tool that changes something (create or rename projects, visitor access controls, forms and form submissions, environment variables, deploys, extension installs, Claude Design imports) on either tool surface (the netlify-*-services-updater selectors or the per-operation netlify-<domain>-<operation> tools), plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-coding-guidance
permissions.description: Fetch Netlify's coding guidance and agent skills for functions, edge functions, blobs, database, forms, configuration and deploys (get-netlify-coding-context; netlify-coding-rules is the same tool's name on the local server).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-account
permissions.description: Look up the signed-in user's profile, their teams and team-level environment variables (netlify-user-services-reader, netlify-team-services-reader and the per-operation get-user, get-teams, get-team, get-team-env-vars tools).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-projects
permissions.description: List projects (sites), inspect a project's settings and list its forms (netlify-project-services-reader and the per-operation get-projects, get-project, get-forms-for-project tools).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-deploys
permissions.description: Inspect deploys and build status by deploy ID or for a site (netlify-deploy-services-reader and the per-operation get-deploy, get-deploy-for-site tools).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-extensions
permissions.description: Browse available Netlify extensions, read an extension's details and fetch the written setup steps for adding a Netlify Database (netlify-extension-services-reader and the per-operation get-extensions, get-full-extension-details, netlify-get-database-setup-steps tools). Does not install or provision anything.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-read-observability
permissions.description: Query a site's edge traffic analytics: request counts, top-k rankings, time series, request logs and single request details (netlify-observability-services-reader and the per-operation get-counts, get-topk, get-timeseries, get-request-logs, get-request-detail tools).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-write-projects
permissions.description: Create and rename projects, change visitor access controls (password or SSO protection), toggle Netlify Forms and delete form submissions, and manage a project's environment variables (netlify-project-services-updater and all per-operation project write tools).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-write-env-vars
permissions.description: Read, create, update or delete a project's environment variables via the per-operation tool only (netlify-project-manage-env-vars). On the default selector surface the same operation runs through netlify-project-services-updater, covered by netlify-mcp-write-projects.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-write-forms
permissions.description: Enable or disable Netlify Forms processing and read or permanently delete form submissions via the per-operation tools only (netlify-project-update-forms, netlify-project-manage-form-submissions). On the default selector surface these run through netlify-project-services-updater, covered by netlify-mcp-write-projects.

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-deploy-sites
permissions.description: Publish a new deploy of a project to an existing Netlify site, making it live (netlify-deploy-services-updater and the per-operation netlify-deploy-site tool).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-write-extensions
permissions.description: Install or uninstall Netlify extensions for a team (netlify-extension-services-updater and the per-operation netlify-extension-change-extension-installation tool).

permissions.name: netlify-mcp-import-designs
permissions.description: Deploy a Claude Design export to a new Netlify site and check the status of that import (import-claude-design-from-url, get-design-import-job-status). These tools are only offered to Claude clients.

ngrok.description: All requests to the ngrok API.

permissions.name: ngrok-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from the ngrok API.

permissions.name: ngrok-write-all
permissions.description: Create, update, delete, or run actions (e.g. restart/stop a tunnel session) through the ngrok API.

permissions.name: ngrok-read-credentials
permissions.description: List and inspect tunnel credentials (the ngrok agent authtokens used to bring up tunnels).

permissions.name: ngrok-write-credentials
permissions.description: Mint, update, or delete tunnel credentials (create the ngrok agent authtokens used to bring up tunnels).

openrouter.description: All requests to the OpenRouter API.

permissions.name: openrouter-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from the OpenRouter API: list models and providers, and read key, credit, and generation metadata.

permissions.name: openrouter-write-all
permissions.description: Create, update, or delete through the OpenRouter API: manage API keys, workspaces, guardrails, files, and account settings. Also covers running inference.

permissions.name: openrouter-inference
permissions.description: Run models through the OpenRouter inference endpoints (POST chat/completions, messages, responses, embeddings, rerank, images, videos, and audio speech/transcriptions), which consume credits. Verified against the OpenRouter OpenAPI spec.

otter-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Otter.ai hosted MCP server (mcp.otter.ai).

permissions.name: otter-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Otter.ai content.

permissions.name: otter-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any Otter.ai MCP tool (search meetings by date, attendee, topic, keyword or title; read a meeting's full transcript, summary, outline and action items; see the connected account) plus the MCP session handshake. Otter's hosted MCP server is read-only, so this covers every tool it offers; nothing can be created, changed or deleted.

permissions.name: otter-mcp-search-meetings
permissions.description: Search your Otter meetings by date, attendee, topic, keyword, folder, channel or title and see their summaries, outlines and action items.

permissions.name: otter-mcp-read-transcripts
permissions.description: Read the full speaker-attributed transcript of a specific Otter meeting, together with its summary, outline, action items and attendees.

permissions.name: otter-mcp-read-account
permissions.description: See the name and email of the connected Otter account.

paypal-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the PayPal hosted MCP server (mcp.paypal.com, or mcp.sandbox.paypal.com for the sandbox).

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify PayPal data.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only PayPal MCP tool (view invoices, products, subscriptions, orders, refunds, disputes, shipment tracking, transactions and sales insights) plus the MCP session handshake. Never moves money or changes anything.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any PayPal MCP tool that changes or moves something: create, edit, send and delete invoices, manage products, subscription plans and subscriptions, add shipment tracking, create and capture orders, issue refunds, check out carts and accept dispute claims; plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-invoices
permissions.description: View invoices and recurring invoice series: list, search and open them, generate an invoice QR code or the next invoice number. Does not change or send anything.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-products
permissions.description: View the product catalog and product details, and search the gift card catalog.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-subscriptions
permissions.description: View subscription plans and the details of individual subscriptions.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-payments
permissions.description: View the details of orders and refunds.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-disputes
permissions.description: View open and past disputes and their details.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-shipments
permissions.description: View shipment tracking information for transactions.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-read-reports
permissions.description: View transaction history and sales or order analytics.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-write-invoices
permissions.description: Create and edit invoices and recurring invoice series, set up or cancel automatic reminders, record payments or refunds made outside PayPal, and cancel sent invoices. Does not send invoices to customers or delete them.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-send-invoices
permissions.description: Send invoices and payment reminders to customers by email.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-delete-invoices
permissions.description: Permanently delete draft invoices and recurring invoice series.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-write-products
permissions.description: Create and edit products in the catalog.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-write-subscriptions
permissions.description: Create and edit subscription plans, and create, change or cancel customer subscriptions.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-write-shipments
permissions.description: Add or update shipment tracking information on transactions.

permissions.name: paypal-mcp-move-money
permissions.description: Move money: create and capture orders, issue refunds to buyers, build and check out gift card carts, and accept dispute claims in the buyer's favor (which refunds them).

peloton-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Peloton hosted MCP server (mcp.onepeloton.com).

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Peloton content.

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Search the Peloton class library, view class details and draft weekly training plans, plus the MCP session handshake. Nothing is added to the member's Peloton account.

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Add classes to the member's Peloton calendar, plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-read-classes
permissions.description: Search Peloton classes by natural language (instructor, duration, discipline, music, difficulty) and view the details of a class.

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-create-training-plans
permissions.description: Draft an interactive weekly training plan (up to 14 days) from Peloton classes and rest days. The plan is only displayed; it does not change the member's Peloton schedule.

permissions.name: peloton-mcp-schedule-classes
permissions.description: Add Peloton classes at chosen dates and times to the member's Peloton calendar.

posthog-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the PostHog hosted MCP server (mcp.posthog.com, or mcp-eu.posthog.com for EU Cloud projects).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify PostHog content.

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only PostHog MCP tool, i.e. the same set PostHog's own read-only mode exposes (SQL and analytics queries, insights, dashboards, feature flag and experiment lookups, error tracking, logs, replays, surveys, warehouse and workspace lookups), plus the MCP session handshake. Works in both the per-tool mode and the default CLI mode, where tools are invoked through the exec tool ("call <tool>") and discovered with its help, learn, tools, search, info and schema commands.

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any PostHog MCP tool that creates, modifies, deletes or triggers something (feature flags, experiments, insights, dashboards, notebooks, cohorts, surveys, workflows, warehouse tables, project settings, ...), plus the MCP session handshake. Works in both the per-tool mode and the default CLI mode, where tools are invoked through the exec tool ("call <tool>"); the exec discovery commands (help, learn, tools, search, info, schema) that CLI-mode clients need to find tools are included as well.

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-workspace
permissions.description: View organization and project settings, members, roles, access control rules, billing and usage, integrations, reverse proxies, SSO configuration, approval requests, comments, support tickets and MCP connections, and discover what the PostHog MCP server can do: the CLI-mode exec commands (help, learn, tools, search, info, schema), the render-ui visualization tool, PostHog documentation search, app URL building, the MCP apps debug tool and sending product feedback (organizations-get, projects-get, org-members-list, billing-*, integration-get, docs-search, generate-app-url, agent-feedback, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-workspace
permissions.description: Change organization and project settings: create projects, switch the active organization or project, manage access control rules, roles, SSO, approvals, integrations, reverse proxies, comments and support tickets (switch-project, project-create, project-settings-update, access-control-*-execute, proxy-create, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-analytics
permissions.description: Run analytics queries and read their results, and view insights, dashboards and notebooks: HogQL/SQL (execute-sql), trends, funnels, retention, paths, lifecycle and stickiness queries, saved insights, web, marketing and metrics queries, heatmaps, AI citation tracking, dashboards and their tiles, subscriptions, alerts, annotations, notebooks, canvases and Streamlit apps (insight-query, query-*, insights-list, dashboard-get, alerts-list, notebooks-get, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-analytics
permissions.description: Create, update and delete saved insights, heatmaps, conversion goals, tracked AI prompts and web analytics rules, dashboards and their tiles, subscriptions, alerts and annotations, and create, edit, run and delete notebooks (including running their SQL and Python cells), canvases and Streamlit apps (insight-create, insight-delete, dashboard-create, dashboard-delete, alert-create, notebooks-create, notebooks-run, canvas-create, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-experimentation
permissions.description: View feature flags, their definitions, status and scheduled changes, early access features, experiments and their results, holdouts and shared metrics, and autoresearch pipelines (feature-flag-get-all, feature-flag-get-definition, early-access-feature-list, experiment-list, experiment-results-get, autoresearch-list, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-experimentation
permissions.description: Create, update, enable, disable, roll out, archive and delete feature flags, scheduled changes and early access features; create, launch, pause, end, ship and delete experiments, holdouts and shared metrics; and manage autoresearch pipelines (create-feature-flag, update-feature-flag, delete-feature-flag, feature-flag-roll-out-to-everyone, experiment-create, experiment-launch, experiment-ship-variant, experiment-delete, autoresearch-create, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-people-and-customers
permissions.description: Look up persons and their properties, view cohorts, and view customer analytics: accounts, contacts, deals, meetings, usage and health scores, feature requests, account notebooks and relationship definitions (persons-list, persons-retrieve, cohorts-list, accounts-list, accounts-retrieve, accounts-meetings-list, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-people-and-customers
permissions.description: Set or delete person properties, delete persons, create or update cohorts, and create, update and delete customer analytics accounts, contacts, custom properties, deals, feature requests, relationship definitions and account notebooks (persons-property-set, persons-bulk-delete, cohorts-create, accounts-create, accounts-destroy, accounts-custom-property-values-create, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-data
permissions.description: Explore the event schema (events, actions, event and person property definitions, data quality check results), the data warehouse (tables, saved queries, external data sources and their sync status, the data catalog, SQL variables and query endpoints) and data pipelines (CDP destinations, transformations and sources, their templates and invocation logs, and batch exports) (read-data-schema, actions-get-all, view-list, external-data-sources-list, endpoint-get, cdp-functions-list, batch-export-get, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-data
permissions.description: Create, update and delete actions, event and property definitions and data quality checks, and create, update, run, materialize and delete saved queries, warehouse tables, external data sources and schemas, data catalog entries and query endpoints (action-create, event-definition-create, data-quality-check-run, view-create, view-run, view-materialize, warehouse-tables-create, external-data-sources-*, endpoint-create, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-pipelines
permissions.description: Create, update, publish, test-invoke and delete data pipeline destinations, transformations and sources (Hog functions) and batch exports, which can send project data to external systems (cdp-functions-create, cdp-functions-publish, cdp-functions-delete, batch-export-create, batch-export-delete, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-monitoring
permissions.description: View monitoring data: error tracking issues, occurrences, stack traces and rules, logs and tracing spans and log alerts, session recordings, playlists and Replay Vision scanners, LLM analytics (generations, traces, costs, evaluations, datasets and managed prompts), and Signals inbox reports, scouts, anomaly scores and activity summaries (query-error-tracking-issues-list, query-logs, query-session-recordings-list, get-llm-total-costs-for-project, llma-*-list, inbox-reports-list, anomaly-search, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-monitoring
permissions.description: Change error tracking issue status and assignment, merge or split issues and manage error tracking rules, settings and alerts; create, update and delete log alerts; delete session recordings, manage playlists and Replay Vision scanners; create, update and delete LLM evaluations, clustering jobs, datasets and managed prompts; and act on Signals inbox reports and scouts (error-tracking-issues-partial-update, error-tracking-issues-merge-create, logs-alerts-create, session-recording-delete, vision-scanners-create, llma-evaluation-create, llma-prompt-create, inbox-report-actions-run, scout-run-now, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-messaging-and-surveys
permissions.description: View messaging workflows, broadcasts, email templates, message categories and opt-outs, and surveys and their responses and statistics (workflows-list, workflows-get, workflows-blast-radius, message-categories-list, opt-outs-list, surveys-get-all, survey-get, survey-stats, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-messaging-and-surveys
permissions.description: Create, update, test-run, enable, archive and convert messaging workflows and broadcasts, manage email templates and message categories, change the opt-out list, and create, update, launch, stop and delete surveys (workflows-create, workflows-update, broadcasts-create, opt-outs-add, survey-create, survey-launch, survey-stop, survey-delete, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-read-agents-and-engineering
permissions.description: View PostHog AI agent work and engineering tooling: agent tasks, channels and runs, the project knowledge used by agents (business knowledge libraries and documents, context wiki pages, skills and skill files, field notes, reminders and PostHog AI chat threads), AI code reviews (PostHog Review, Stamphog), visual review runs and CI/test analytics (tasks-list, channel-list, skill-list, context-wiki-page-retrieve, business-knowledge-documents-search, review-hog-reviews-list, engineering-analytics-flaky-tests, ...).

permissions.name: posthog-mcp-write-agents-and-engineering
permissions.description: Create and run agent tasks and channels, create, update and archive the project knowledge used by agents (business knowledge libraries, context wiki pages, skills and skill files, field notes and reminders), trigger code reviews and Stamphog digests, and change visual review settings and quarantines (tasks-create, tasks-run-create, channel-create, skill-create, context-wiki-page-update, reminder-create, review-hog-reviews-trigger, stamphog-review-runs-create, ...).

ramp.description: Any interaction with the Ramp API.

permissions.name: ramp-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from Ramp: every read capability across all resources (transactions, cards, bills, reimbursements, treasury, vendors, users, accounting, trips, limits, and more). Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities.

permissions.name: ramp-write-all
permissions.description: Create or modify anything in Ramp: every write capability across all resources (activate/lock cards, approve transactions & reimbursements, edit limits, issue funds, manage trips & vendors, pay via x402, and more). Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities.

permissions.name: ramp-read-accounting
permissions.description: Read accounting / analyst queries. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: execute analyst query, get analyst artifact status, get analyst catalog, get analyst metric metadata, get analyst spend facts domain docs, get analyst table domain docs, get tracking categories, get tracking category options.

permissions.name: ramp-read-ai-spend
permissions.description: Read AI token spend. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get ai token spend aggregates, get ai token spend connections, get ai token spend current spend, get ai token spend filter options.

permissions.name: ramp-read-bills
permissions.description: Read bills. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get bill amount summary, get bill comments, get bill details, get bill history, get bill invoices, get bill metrics, get bill status, get bills for approval, get draft bill details, get recurring bill, list bills, search bills.

permissions.name: ramp-read-cards
permissions.description: Read cards. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: enroll business in agent cards, get agent card creds, get agent card funds.

permissions.name: ramp-read-help-center
permissions.description: Read Ramp help-center articles. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: search help center snippets.

permissions.name: ramp-read-limits
permissions.description: Read spend limits & allocations. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get funds, list cards.

permissions.name: ramp-read-memos
permissions.description: Read transaction memos. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get transaction suggested memos.

permissions.name: ramp-read-purchase-orders
permissions.description: Read purchase orders. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get purchase order details, search purchase orders.

permissions.name: ramp-read-reimbursements
permissions.description: Read out-of-pocket reimbursements. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: estimate mileage reimbursement, estimate per diem amount, get outstanding reimbursements by currency, get reimbursement receipts, get reimbursements, get reimbursements for approval, get user recent reimbursements, search reimbursements, search user reimbursements.

permissions.name: ramp-read-tasks
permissions.description: Read attention feed / tasks. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get attention feed.

permissions.name: ramp-read-transactions
permissions.description: Read card transactions. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: answer policy question, get decline explanation, get full transaction metadata, get transaction missing items, get transactions.

permissions.name: ramp-read-treasury
permissions.description: Read treasury / business account balances. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get account balance history, get investment account balance, get managed portfolio account balance, get ramp business account balance, get treasury balance history, list business accounts, list treasury accounts, list wallet transfers.

permissions.name: ramp-read-trips
permissions.description: Read travel & trips. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get bookings, get candidate trips for transaction, get flight booking locations, get traveler profile, get user trips, search flights, submit flight booking.

permissions.name: ramp-read-unified-requests
permissions.description: Read unified requests (approvals inbox). Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get requests to review, get unified request details, search unified requests.

permissions.name: ramp-read-users
permissions.description: Read users & org chart. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get org chart, get simplified user detail, list users, search user.

permissions.name: ramp-read-vendors
permissions.description: Read vendors. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: get vendor agreement, get vendor document bulk status, list vendor agreements, search vendors.

permissions.name: ramp-write-approvals
permissions.description: Create or modify approval decisions. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: approve or reject request.

permissions.name: ramp-write-cards
permissions.description: Create or modify cards. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: activate card, lock or unlock card.

permissions.name: ramp-write-comments
permissions.description: Create or modify comments. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: post comment.

permissions.name: ramp-write-funds
permissions.description: Create or modify agent-card funds. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: issue one off funds.

permissions.name: ramp-write-limits
permissions.description: Create or modify spend limits & allocations. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: limit increase, lock or unlock spend allocation, lock or unlock spend allocation member, update category restrictions, update merchant restrictions, update transaction amount limit.

permissions.name: ramp-write-receipts
permissions.description: Create or modify receipts. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: attach receipt to transaction, mark transaction missing receipt, provide no receipt reason, upload receipt file.

permissions.name: ramp-write-reimbursements
permissions.description: Create or modify out-of-pocket reimbursements. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: approve or reject reimbursement, cancel reimbursement payment, create reimbursement from receipt, duplicate reimbursement, edit reimbursement, resubmit reimbursement, submit reimbursement.

permissions.name: ramp-write-transactions
permissions.description: Create or modify card transactions. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: approve or reject transaction, edit transaction, request transaction repayment.

permissions.name: ramp-write-trips
permissions.description: Create or modify travel & trips. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: create trip, update traveler profile.

permissions.name: ramp-write-vendors
permissions.description: Create or modify vendors. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: attach vendor document, bulk upload vendor documents.

permissions.name: ramp-write-x402
permissions.description: Create or modify x402 protocol payments. Limited to Ramp's agent-tools capabilities. Includes: pay with x402.

readwise-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Readwise hosted MCP server (mcp2.readwise.io).

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Readwise content.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: View anything in Readwise without changing it: search and list highlights, the Daily Review, Reader documents and tags, document exports, the Books library, reading sessions and stats, and public feed tokens. Also includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Make any change in Readwise: create, edit, tag or delete highlights; save, move, retag and edit Reader documents; add, edit or remove books and reading sessions; and create or revoke public feed tokens. Also includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-read-highlights
permissions.description: Search and list highlights in the Highlights library, see today's Daily Review, and view the highlights on a Reader document.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-write-highlights
permissions.description: Create new highlights, edit a highlight's text, note, location or tags, and add or remove tags and notes on Reader highlights. Does not allow deleting highlights.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-delete-highlights
permissions.description: Permanently delete a highlight from the Highlights library.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-read-documents
permissions.description: Search and list Reader documents, view a document's details and full content, and list the tags in the Reader library.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-write-documents
permissions.description: Save new documents to Reader, move documents between inbox, later, shortlist, archive and feed, edit document metadata in bulk, and add or remove tags on documents.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-export-documents
permissions.description: Start an export of all Reader documents and check its status to obtain the download link.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-read-books
permissions.description: View the Books library, reading sessions, daily reading totals, and reading stats and goals.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-write-books
permissions.description: Add books to the library, change a book's shelf, dates, rating or review, log reading sessions, and edit session captions. Does not allow deleting books or sessions.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-delete-books
permissions.description: Remove books from the library and delete reading sessions along with their XP and feed posts.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-read-public-tokens
permissions.description: List the tokens that let outside sites read the public book feed.

permissions.name: readwise-mcp-write-public-tokens
permissions.description: Create or revoke tokens that let outside sites read the public book feed.

supabase-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Supabase hosted MCP server (mcp.supabase.com).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Supabase content.

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only Supabase MCP tool (inspect database schema and migrations, read logs and advisors, project URLs and API keys, generated types, Edge Function source, organizations and projects, costs, docs search, branches, storage config, notebooks) plus the MCP session handshake. Does not include execute_sql.

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any Supabase MCP tool that changes something: execute SQL, apply migrations, deploy Edge Functions and secrets, create/pause/restore projects, create/merge/rebase/reset/delete branches, update storage config, create and run notebooks, and send feedback, plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-database
permissions.description: Inspect the database schema: list tables (with columns and keys), installed Postgres extensions, and applied migrations (list_tables, list_extensions, list_migrations).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-execute-sql

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-database

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-logs

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-development
permissions.description: Fetch a project's API URL and publishable/anon API keys, and generate TypeScript types from the database schema (get_project_url, get_publishable_keys, get_anon_key, generate_typescript_types).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-edge-functions
permissions.description: List a project's Edge Functions and read their source code (list_edge_functions, get_edge_function).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-edge-functions
permissions.description: Deploy Edge Functions, replacing any existing function with the same name, and create or update Edge Function secrets (deploy_edge_function, create_edge_function_secret).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-projects
permissions.description: View the organizations and projects the account can access, including plan details, and look up and acknowledge the cost of a new project or branch (list_organizations, get_organization, list_projects, get_project, get_cost, confirm_cost).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-projects
permissions.description: Create new Supabase projects, which can add to the organization's bill, and pause or restore existing projects (create_project, pause_project, restore_project).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-docs
permissions.description: Search the Supabase documentation (search_docs).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-branches
permissions.description: List a project's development branches and their status (list_branches).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-branches
permissions.description: Create development branches (which can incur usage charges), merge a branch's migrations and Edge Functions into production, and rebase a branch onto production (create_branch, merge_branch, rebase_branch).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-delete-branches
permissions.description: Delete a development branch or reset its migrations, discarding untracked changes (delete_branch, reset_branch).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-storage
permissions.description: List a project's storage buckets and view its storage configuration (list_storage_buckets, get_storage_config).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-storage
permissions.description: Change a project's storage configuration such as file size limits and image transformation settings (update_storage_config).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-read-notebooks
permissions.description: List a project's SQL notebooks and read their cells (list_notebooks, get_notebook).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-write-notebooks
permissions.description: Create notebooks and run their database and log query cells, which can modify data unless the server is in read-only mode (create_notebook, run_notebook).

permissions.name: supabase-mcp-send-feedback
permissions.description: Send feedback about the MCP tools to the Supabase team, or delete feedback sent earlier (submit_feedback, delete_feedback).

tailscale.description: All requests to the Tailscale admin REST API (api.tailscale.com), which is served under /api/v2/. Covers tailnet-wide user management (roles, approval, suspension, deletion), device management, ACL/policy, DNS, keys, logs, and webhooks. Does not cover the admin console (console.tailscale.com) or the sign-in host (login.tailscale.com), which the browser login visits but which are not API targets.

permissions.name: tailscale-read-all
permissions.description: Read anything from the Tailscale admin API: list users, devices, keys, webhooks, posture integrations, services, tailnets, DNS and logging configuration, and the policy file. Safe methods only.

permissions.name: tailscale-write-all
permissions.description: Change anything through the Tailscale admin API: change user roles, approve/suspend/restore/delete users, authorize/expire/delete devices, set device tags/routes/names, set the policy file, configure DNS and logging, create and revoke keys, and manage webhooks and OAuth apps. Covers every unsafe method.

permissions.name: tailscale-read-users
permissions.description: Read user information and invitations: list users and user invites, get a user's details. Safe methods on the users and user-invites endpoints only. Maps to Tailscale's own OAuth `users:read` scope.

permissions.name: tailscale-write-users
permissions.description: Change user roles and handle user approval, suspension, deletion, and restoration; create and resend user invites. Unsafe methods on the users and user-invites endpoints only. Maps to Tailscale's own OAuth `users` scope.

permissions.name: tailscale-read-devices
permissions.description: Read device information: list tailnet devices, get a device's details, posture attributes, and routes. Safe methods on the device and device-invites endpoints only. Maps to Tailscale's own OAuth `devices:read` scope.

permissions.name: tailscale-write-devices
permissions.description: Add or edit machines: authorize, expire, rename, retag, re-route, or delete devices, and manage device invites and posture attributes. Unsafe methods on the device and device-invites endpoints only. Maps to Tailscale's own OAuth `devices` scope.

permissions.name: tailscale-read-keys
permissions.description: Read the tailnet's keys: list and inspect auth keys (tskey-auth, for the tailscale CLI), API access tokens, OAuth clients, and federated identities. Safe methods on the keys endpoint only. Tailscale's own OAuth model splits this across `auth_keys:read`, `api_access_tokens:read`, `oauth_keys:read`, and `federated_keys:read`, but those are all served by the same `/tailnet/{tailnet}/keys` endpoint and cannot be separated by path.

permissions.name: tailscale-write-keys
permissions.description: Mint, update, or revoke any key the tailnet's keys endpoint serves: auth keys (tskey-auth, which the tailscale CLI consumes to bring up nodes), API access tokens, OAuth clients, and federated identities. Unsafe methods on the keys endpoint only. Note that minting an OAuth client or federated identity creates a long-lived credential that can mint further access tokens, so this scope is broader than Tailscale's own `auth_keys` OAuth scope (which covers device auth keys only) -- detent matches by method and path, not request body, so the keyType field that distinguishes them cannot be narrowed here. This is the scope an agent needs to connect new machines to the tailnet.

ticktick-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the TickTick hosted MCP server (mcp.ticktick.com).

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify TickTick content.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only TickTick MCP tool (search and list tasks, lists, folders, sections, tags, comments, members, habits and check-ins, focus records, connected calendars, countdowns) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any TickTick MCP tool that creates, modifies or deletes content (tasks, checklist items, comments, assignments, lists, sections, folders, tags, habits and check-ins, focus records) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-tasks
permissions.description: Look up tasks: search by keyword, list undone or completed tasks for a date range, filter tasks by list, priority, tag or status, and read a task and its comments.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-tasks
permissions.description: Create and edit tasks (singly or in batches), mark tasks and checklist items complete, move tasks between lists, add comments, and assign or unassign tasks. Does not delete anything.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-delete-tasks
permissions.description: Move tasks to the Trash and delete task comments.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-lists
permissions.description: View lists (projects), their sections, the folders that group them, the members of shared lists, and the undone tasks in a list.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-lists
permissions.description: Create and edit lists (projects), their sections, and the folders that group them, including dissolving a folder so its lists become ungrouped. Does not delete lists or tasks.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-tags
permissions.description: View all tags in the account.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-tags
permissions.description: Create, rename and recolor tags, or delete a tag (which also removes it from every task).

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-habits
permissions.description: View habits, habit sections, and habit check-in history.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-habits
permissions.description: Create and edit habits, and record or correct habit check-ins.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-focus-records
permissions.description: View focus (Pomodoro) records, individually or by time range.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-write-focus-records
permissions.description: Add, edit and delete focus (Pomodoro) records.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-calendar-events
permissions.description: View the third-party calendar accounts connected to TickTick and the events on those calendars.

permissions.name: ticktick-mcp-read-countdowns
permissions.description: View countdowns.

todoist.description: Any request to the Todoist API.

permissions.name: todoist-write-all

permissions.name: todoist-read-projects

permissions.name: todoist-write-projects

permissions.name: todoist-read-sections

permissions.name: todoist-read-tasks

permissions.name: todoist-read-comments

permissions.name: todoist-read-labels

permissions.name: todoist-write-labels

permissions.name: todoist-sync
