trello-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Trello hosted MCP server (mcp.trello.com).

permissions.name: trello-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Trello content.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: View anything in Trello: your profile, workspaces, boards, lists, cards, checklists, comments, Inbox cards and Planner events, and search across boards and cards. Nothing is created or changed.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Create and change things in Trello: boards, lists, cards (including moving, archiving, labels and comments), checklists, Inbox cards and Planner events. Trello MCP does not permanently delete anything.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-profile
permissions.description: View your own Trello profile and preferences, such as your name and time zone.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-boards
permissions.description: View workspaces, boards, their labels and the lists on them.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-write-boards
permissions.description: Create boards and create, rename or move lists on them.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-cards
permissions.description: View cards, their comments, and their checklists and checklist items.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-write-cards
permissions.description: Create and edit cards: move, archive or complete them, add or remove labels and comments, and create or update checklists and their items.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-search
permissions.description: Search for boards and cards by keyword.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-inbox
permissions.description: View the cards in your personal Trello Inbox.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-write-inbox
permissions.description: Create, edit and archive cards in your personal Trello Inbox.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-read-planner
permissions.description: View your Trello Planner calendar and its events.

permissions.name: trello-mcp-write-planner
permissions.description: Create focus-time events in Trello Planner and link or unlink cards to events.

vercel-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Vercel hosted MCP server (mcp.vercel.com).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Vercel content.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Run any read-only Vercel MCP tool (teams, projects, deployments, build and runtime logs, observability, Web Analytics, domains and DNS, environment variables, feature flags, firewall, Global Config, integrations, routing, sandboxes, storage, CI, agent runs, toolbar threads, docs) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Run any Vercel MCP tool that creates or changes something (projects, deployments, promotions and rollbacks, domains, DNS, purchases, environment variables, feature flags, firewall, Global Config, connectors, KMS keys, routing, sandboxes and command execution, storage, Drains, toolbar threads, CI retries, feedback) plus the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-account
permissions.description: See who is signed in, their teams, team members, access groups and the team activity log, view billing charges and contract commitments, and search the Vercel documentation and CLI guidance (get_auth_user, list_teams, list_team_members, list_billing_charges, search_vercel_documentation, use_vercel_cli, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-send-feedback
permissions.description: Send feedback about Vercel to Vercel.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-projects-and-deployments
permissions.description: List and inspect projects and their settings, deployments with their build logs, files and events, rolling releases, Vercel CI runs and their logs, and runs of agents built with eve; also fetch content from a deployment URL and browse the Git repositories available to link (list_projects, get_project, list_deployments, get_deployment_build_logs, get_rolling_release, list_vercel_ci_invocations, list_agent_runs, ...). Includes get_project_deletion_link, which only returns a dashboard link.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-projects-and-deployments
permissions.description: Create and change projects (settings, pausing, project domains, deployment protection and bypass), create or cancel deployments, change which deployment serves production traffic by promoting, rolling back or running a rolling release, re-request deployment checks and retry Vercel CI runs (create_project, update_project, create_deployment, deploy_to_vercel, request_promote, request_rollback, retry_vercel_ci_invocation, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-domains-and-routing
permissions.description: List and inspect domains, DNS records, certificates and domain orders, check domain availability and prices (including read-only purchase quotes), view routing rules, redirects, their version history and aliases, and read the firewall configuration, bypass rules and active attack status (list_domains, get_records, search_domains, list_project_routes, list_aliases, get_firewall_config, ...). Also drafts a routing rule from a description without saving it (generate_route).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-domains-and-routing
permissions.description: Add or transfer domains, create, update or replace DNS records, issue certificates, add, edit and stage routing rules and redirects, assign aliases, change URL protection bypass, and change the firewall configuration including Attack Challenge mode (create_or_transfer_domain, create_record, add_route, stage_redirects, assign_alias, put_firewall_config, ...). Does not buy domains; that needs vercel-mcp-make-purchases.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-make-purchases
permissions.description: Spend money on behalf of the team: register (buy) domains and, where still exposed, buy a Pro plan, prepaid credits or add-ons (buy_domain, buy_domains, buy_single_domain, buy_pro, buy_credits, buy_addon).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-configuration
permissions.description: Read project and shared environment variables including their decrypted values, custom environments, feature flags, flag segments and SDK keys, Global Configs (Edge Config) with their items, read tokens and backups, integration configurations, webhooks and connectors, and KMS issuers (filter_project_envs, get_project_env, list_flags, get_edge_config_items, list_connectors, list_kms_issuers, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-configuration
permissions.description: Create and edit environment variables, feature flags, flag segments, flag settings and SDK keys, create and update Global Configs (Edge Config), their items, read tokens and backups, change connector settings and project connections, and manage KMS issuers, policies and signing keys including activating and revoking them (create_project_env, create_flag, patch_edge_config_items, update_connector, create_kms_issuer, revoke_kms_signing_key, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-observability-and-analytics
permissions.description: Read runtime logs, grouped runtime errors and request traces, query observability data and its schema, inspect configured Drains, and query Web Analytics page views and custom events (get_runtime_logs, get_runtime_errors, create_observability_query, list_drains, count_pageviews, aggregate_events, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-observability-and-analytics
permissions.description: Create, update and test Drains that send logs, traces and analytics data to external destinations, and mint trace session tokens (create_drain, update_drain, test_drain, create_trace_session). No tool changes Web Analytics data itself.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-storage-and-sandboxes
permissions.description: Inspect Blob stores, build cache artifacts and Remote Caching status, and inspect sandboxes and their sessions: list sessions, commands and snapshots, read command output and read files inside a sandbox (get_storage_stores_by_id, artifact_query, list_named_sandboxes, list_sessions, get_session_command_logs, read_session_file, ...).

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-storage-and-sandboxes
permissions.description: Create Blob stores, upload build cache artifacts and invalidate cached content, and create and manage sandboxes: run and kill commands inside them, write files, take snapshots, extend timeouts, change network policy and stop sessions (create_storage_stores_blob, upload_artifact, invalidate_by_tags, create_sandboxes_v4, run_session_command, write_session_files, ...). Commands run inside isolated Vercel sandboxes.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-read-toolbar
permissions.description: Read Vercel Toolbar comment threads and their messages.

permissions.name: vercel-mcp-write-toolbar
permissions.description: Reply to Vercel Toolbar comment threads, edit messages, add reactions and resolve or reopen threads.

webflow-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Webflow hosted MCP server (mcp.webflow.com).

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-session
permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Webflow content.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-read-all
permissions.description: Use every Webflow MCP tool that only looks things up: site analytics (Analyze, AEO and Optimize reports), image previews and canvas snapshots, Webflow's built-in assistant and workflow guidance. Most other Webflow tools can both view and change a site and are therefore in the write permission. Includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-all
permissions.description: Use every Webflow MCP tool that can change a site or workspace: pages, CMS content, page elements, components, styles, assets, forms, comments, translations, custom code, access and settings, Webflow Cloud apps, campaigns, agent instructions, the live Designer session, and publishing. These tools also view the things they manage. Includes the MCP session handshake.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-read-analytics
permissions.description: View site analytics: visitor traffic, top pages, engagement and goals (Analyze), how AI assistants and crawlers see and cite the site (AEO), and the results of A/B tests and optimizations (Optimize). Read-only.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-read-guidance
permissions.description: Ask Webflow's built-in assistant questions about Webflow, read the recommended workflows and best practices, and request extra tools for capabilities not already available. Does not look at or change any site.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-read-previews
permissions.description: View images: preview an image from a site's asset library, or capture a picture of how an element currently looks on the Designer canvas (requires the Designer to be open).

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-sites
permissions.description: List the sites the connection can access, view a site's details, and publish a site so changes go live.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-pages
permissions.description: List pages, create new pages and edit page settings such as titles, slugs, SEO and structured data; manage page branches and choose which pages and CMS items appear in the sitemap.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-cms
permissions.description: View, create, edit and delete CMS collections, their fields and their items (blog posts, team members, products and other structured content), including publishing items live.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-localization
permissions.description: Read the text of pages and components and translate it into a site's secondary languages.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-design
permissions.description: Design pages in the Designer: inspect, add, move, remove and edit the elements on a page (including from HTML and CSS); create and edit reusable components, their properties and variants, and place component instances; create and edit styles (classes), design variables such as colors and spacing, and animations and interactions; and work with a live Designer session (see the current page, branch and selection, select elements, move around the canvas, create page folders). The live-session actions require the Designer to be open.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-assets
permissions.description: Upload, organize, update, compress and delete images, files, asset folders and custom fonts in a site's asset library.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-comments
permissions.description: Read comment threads left on a site in the Designer, look up who took part in them, and post replies.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-campaigns-and-forms
permissions.description: Manage marketing campaigns and forms: generate campaign landing pages, create and edit page variations and personalized content, and read campaign performance; view a site's forms and their fields, and view, update or delete the submissions people have sent through them.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-custom-code
permissions.description: Add, apply and remove custom code on a site or its pages, including scripts and head and footer code blocks.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-site-settings
permissions.description: Administer a site and workspace: manage who has access and their roles, send invitations, set up redirects, robots.txt and well-known files, manage webhooks that notify other services about site events, review the site activity log, and view, create, edit and delete the rules and skills the site stores to guide AI agents working on it.

permissions.name: webflow-mcp-write-cloud-apps
permissions.description: Inspect and manage Webflow Cloud apps hosted alongside a site: their environments, deployments, domains and logs, including triggering new deployments or deleting apps.

wix-mcp.description: Identifies requests to the Wix hosted MCP server (mcp.wix.com).

permissions.description: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Wix content.

permissions.name: wix-mcp-read-all

permissions.name: wix-mcp-call-site-apis

permissions.name: wix-mcp-send-feedback
